name: Stipend Scheme for Under Graduate and Post Graduate Studies in Indian Statistical Institute, Kolkata
provider: Indian Statistical Institute (Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation)

rules.quote: A monthly Stipend is awarded at the time of admission to each student, which is valid initially for the first semester only.

Sl. No. Programme Stipend (Rs./Month) 1 B.Stat/B.Math 5000 2 PG Diploma in Statistical Methods and Analytics (For students domiciled in the North East States of India) 3000 3 M.Stat/M.Math/MS(QE)/ MS(LIS)/MS(QMS) 8000 4 M.Tech(CS)/M. Tech (CrS)/M.Tech(QROR) 12400
If a student is getting a scholarship from another government agency then the stipend will be discontinued.
